name: WholeStack WF-040: Buyer Selection & Exit Strategy Gate

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json.body||$input.first().json; const d=input.buyer_disposition||{}; const selected=input.selected_buyer||d.selected_buyer||null; const backup=input.backup_buyer||null; const strategy=String(input.exit_strategy??input.disposition_strategy??input.strategy??"").toLowerCase().trim(); const allowed=["assignment","novation","double_close","wholetail","resale","hold","review"]; const strategyValid=allowed.includes(strategy); const contract=input.contract||{}; const contractId=String(input.executed_contract_id??contract.contract_id??"").trim(); const contractPrice=Number(input.contract_price??contract.contract_price); const buyerPrice=Number(input.buyer_purchase_price??selected?.purchase_price??selected?.offer_price); const assignmentFee=Number(input.assignment_fee); const buyerReady=Boolean(selected&&selected.buyer_id&&(selected.status==="selected"||selected.proof_of_funds_verified===true)); const economicsReady=Number.isFinite(contractPrice)&&contractPrice>0&&Number.isFinite(buyerPrice)&&buyerPrice>0; const feeReady=assignmentFee===0||Number.isFinite(assignmentFee); const identityReady=Boolean((d.property_identity||input.property_identity)?.normalized_identity_key||(d.property_identity||input.property_identity)?.parcel_id||(d.property_identity||input.property_identity)?.normalized_address); const contractReady=Boolean(contractId); const readinessReasons=[]; if(!identityReady) readinessReasons.push("property_identity_missing"); if(!contractReady) readinessReasons.push("executed_contract_id_missing"); if(!strategyValid) readinessReasons.push("exit_strategy_missing_or_unsupported"); if(!buyerReady) readinessReasons.push("selected_buyer_not_ready"); if(strategy==="assignment"&&!economicsReady) readinessReasons.push("assignment_economics_missing"); if(strategy==="assignment"&&!feeReady) readinessReasons.push("assignment_fee_invalid"); const status=readinessReasons.length===0?"ready_for_exit":buyerReady&&contractReady?"needs_data":"not_ready"; const next=status==="ready_for_exit"?"prepare_transaction_package":status==="needs_data"?"collect_missing_exit_data":"resolve_buyer_contract_or_strategy"; const spread=economicsReady?buyerPrice-contractPrice:null; return [{json:{...input,exit_strategy_gate:{status,property_identity:d.property_identity||input.property_identity||{},selected_buyer:selected,backup_buyer:backup,exit_strategy:strategy||null,contract:{executed_contract_id:contractId||null,contract_price:Number.isFinite(contractPrice)?contractPrice:null},buyer_economics:{buyer_purchase_price:Number.isFinite(buyerPrice)?buyerPrice:null,assignment_fee:Number.isFinite(assignmentFee)?assignmentFee:null,estimated_gross_spread:spread},readiness:{identity_ready:identityReady,contract_ready:contractReady,buyer_ready:buyerReady,strategy_ready:strategyValid,economics_ready:economicsReady,missing_or_conflicting:readinessReasons},next_action:next,transaction_ready:status==="ready_for_exit",policy:"Decision/readiness management only. This workflow does not create contracts, provide legal advice, negotiate with buyers, verify funds, or execute a closing."}}}];
